orig_text:
measurement //= ( digested-measurement-label => digest )
   measurement //= ( raw-measurement-label => bytes )

   authority-id-type = eat.JC<bytes-b64u, bytes>
   flags-type = eat.JC<bytes8-b64u, bytes8>
correct_text:
measurement //= ( digested-measurement-label => digest )
   measurement //= ( raw-measurement-label => raw-measurement-type )

   raw-measurement-type = eat.JC<bytes-b64u, bytes>
   authority-id-type = eat.JC<bytes-b64u, bytes>
   flags-type = eat.JC<bytes8-b64u, bytes8>
notes:
RFC 10013 specifies both CBOR (application/measured-component+cbor, Content-Format 295) and JSON (application/measured-component+json, Content-Format 296) serializations of measured-component via:

   mc-json = text .json measured-component
   raw-measurement-label = eat.JC<"raw-measurement", 5>

Every other binary field in measured-component (digest-value-type in Section 4.2, authority-id-type in Section 4.3.2, and flags-type in Section 4.3.3) uses eat.JC<bytes-b64u, bytes> (or eat.JC<bytes8-b64u, bytes8>) in accordance with RFC 9711 Section 7.2.2 ("bstr -- MUST be base64url encoded" in JSON).

However, Section 4.3 (and the collated CDDL in Appendix A) defines the value of raw-measurement-label directly as CBOR "bytes" instead of eat.JC<bytes-b64u, bytes>. Per RFC 9741 Section 2.4, the ".json" CDDL control operator parses JSON text into the CBOR data model using the generic JSON-to-CBOR conversion of RFC 8949 Section 6.2, which produces only CBOR map, array, text string, number, boolean, or null, and never produces a CBOR byte string ("bytes", major type 2). Consequently, under the published CDDL, no JSON document can ever satisfy the "raw-measurement" branch of mc-json (including a JSON serialization of Figure 6).

In Appendix A (Collated CDDL), the corresponding lines:

   measurement //= (digested-measurement-label => digest // raw-\
                                             measurement-label => bytes)

should likewise use raw-measurement-type with:

   raw-measurement-type = eat.JC<bytes-b64u, bytes>
